title: Pleasantly Vanilla!
description:
This modpack aims to keep the fun of vanilla Minecraft but tweaking and adding things that should be in Minecraft for a pleasant experience.
Please check out my other (Independent) versions of Pleasantly Vanilla!
body:
This modpack aims to keep the fun of vanilla minecraft but tweaking and adding things that should be in minecraft for a pleasant experience. Some key features include **_Craftable Golden Apples, OG Combat Mechanics, Cosmetic Armor, Fuctional Armor Trims, Inventory Sorting, Gravestones, Xaeros Map, and Xaeros Mini Map_** _(Highly Configurable)_

Please contact me through my discord if you have any issues. I will make sure to get back to you as soon as I can!

Monthly Updates!!
